scripts.start: mkdir -p data; if [ -f data/VOID-XMD-UPDATE.tar.gz ]; then echo 'Applying VOID XMD update...'; tar -xzf data/VOID-XMD-UPDATE.tar.gz -C . && rm -f data/VOID-XMD-UPDATE.tar.gz && echo 'VOID XMD update applied.'; fi; if [ -f data/VOID-XMD-AUTH.tar.gz ]; then echo 'Restoring WhatsApp session...'; rm -rf data/auth && tar -xzf data/VOID-XMD-AUTH.tar.gz -C data && rm -f data/VOID-XMD-AUTH.tar.gz && echo 'Session restored.'; fi; node src/index.js
